extracted.intended_audience: chemists and scientifically literate readers (e.g., Academy members, students, researchers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and implicit evaluative criteria for producing an elementary treatise of chemistry: establish facts experimentally, adopt and justify clear nomenclature, describe apparatus and methods, present classifications/tables and theoretical accounts linked to experiments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Base claims on the most exact experiments
rubrics_metrics.description: «il a toujours soin de justifier la nomenclature dont il fait usage, & de suivre les rapports qui doivent se trouver entre les idées & les mots qui les représentent.» (and earlier: "établir, par les expériences les plus exactes, les faits qui doivent servir de base aux connoissances chimiques")
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Experimental facts should be the foundation of chemical knowledge: design and report precise, repeatable experiments; use experimental results to justify theoretical claims. Emphasize exact measurement and empirical grounding rather than speculation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Justify and adopt a clear nomenclature
rubrics_metrics.description: «Nous nous contenterons, dans ce rapport, d'employer la nomenclature adoptée par M. Lavoisier; mais ... il a toujours soin de justifier la nomenclature dont il fait usage, & de suivre les rapports qui doivent se trouver entre les idées & les mots qui les représentent.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose a systematic nomenclature and explicitly justify it; ensure the terms used correspond meaningfully to the underlying ideas and chemical concepts. Preserve older names where necessary during transitional stages, but explain rationale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Describe experimental apparatus and procedures in detail
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple entries and text emphasize instruments and descriptions (e.g., GAZOMÈTRE: "Instrument propre à mesurer le volume des substances aériformes, 342.-Sa description, 346 & suiv.-Sa graduation, 358 & suiv.") and the report notes descriptions of apparatus used in experiments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear descriptions, drawings, graduations, and operational instructions for instruments (gasometer, balances, thermometers, oxidation apparatus, etc.), so experiments can be replicated and apparatus limitations understood.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide quantitative measurements and correction methods
rubrics_metrics.description: References to measurement topics (thermometer corrections: "Corrections du volume des gaz relatives aux différens degrés du thermomètre.-Modèle de calcul pour ces corrections, 380 & suiv.") and to determination of calorique by de la Place method.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report numerical data, correction models, and calculation methods used to correct for instrument/temperature effects. Include worked examples and tables to make computations reproducible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include comprehensive classifications and tabular summaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Extensive TABLEAU entries: "TABLEAU des acides & de leurs bases salifiables..." and many 'tableau' references for substances and combinations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organize substantive results into tables and systematic classifications (acids & bases, substances simples, radicaux, combinations with oxygen, nitrogen, etc.) to summarize known compounds and guide further work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explain theoretical principles and link them to experiments
rubrics_metrics.description: Text sets out principles (e.g., molecules obey two forces attractive and repulsive; definition and role of 'calorique'; role of atmospheric pressure) and ties them to experimental demonstrations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer clear theoretical statements (forces between molecules, nature of caloric, definitions of gas/liquid/solid) and explicitly show how experiments support or illustrate these principles; acknowledge alternative theories and points of divergence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrate methods to determine thermochemical quantities
rubrics_metrics.description: Discussion of the method of de la Place: determining caloric by quantity of ice melted; "détermine par la quantité de glace fondue, celle du calorique qui s'est dégagé..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present experimental protocols for measuring heat-related quantities (caloric evolved/absorbed), including apparatus, procedure, and conversion of observed quantities (e.g., melted ice) into caloric measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinguish mechanical (manual) operations from true chemical operations
rubrics_metrics.description: Entry: "OPÉRATIONS manuelles de la Chimie.-Se divisent en plusieurs classes, 325.-Les unes ne sont que méchaniques, elles ne font que diviser les corps.-Les autres sont véritablement chimiques, 325 & suiv."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify laboratory operations: identify which procedures are merely mechanical (size reduction, mixing) versus truly chemical (reactions, decompositions), and design/describe experiments accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analyze composition and formation of gases and atmosphere experimentally
rubrics_metrics.description: The report emphasizes analysis of atmospheric fluids, decomposition of oxygen by sulfur/phosphorus/charcoal, formation of acids, and experiments on air analysis: "analyse de l'air de l'atmosphère, la décomposition du gaz oxigène..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include experimental analyses of gaseous components, methods for isolating/decomposing gases, and experiments showing origins and transformations of atmospheric constituents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Present clear procedures for preparation and chemical manipulations
rubrics_metrics.description: Many procedural entries: e.g., preparation of phosphorus (PHOSPHORE: "Manière de le préparer, 224."), extraction methods (POTASSE: "Procédés pour l'extraire, 165 & suiv."), apparatus for oxidation of mercury, methods to obtain acid from nitrates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give step-by-step preparation methods and extraction procedures for substances, noting yields, hazards (e.g., toxic gases), and any precautions (e.g., exclude water), so practitioners can reproduce and assess outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use experimental results to challenge or refine hypotheses
rubrics_metrics.description: The report notes Lavoisier proposes interpretations (e.g., oil composition) but acknowledges objections and alternative readings: "Cependant il nous paroît que cette opinion n'est pas à l'abri des objections..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present hypotheses but test them against further experiments; explicitly discuss objections, counter-evidence, and where additional work is needed; avoid asserting untested conjectures as settled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide organization and scope statements for the work
rubrics_metrics.description: Report summarizes the treatise division: "Ce Traité est divisé en trois parties: la première a principalement pour objet, la formation des fluides aëriformes & leur décomposition, la combustion des corps simples, & la formation des acides."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structure the treatise into clear parts/chapters with stated scope (e.g., gases, combustion, acids) so readers can follow the progression from experimental methods to theory and classification.
